stances.quote: Congresswoman Ann Wagner (R-MO) released the following statement after she voted for H.R. 8800, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
stances.reasoning: Text shows repeated support for NDAA and defense production investments indicating preference for more military spending.

stances.quote: I will always be committed to keeping taxes low for hardworking families
stances.reasoning: Explicit statements favor tax cuts and keeping taxes low for families and businesses.

stances.quote: We are never going to be able to tax, borrow, and spend our way to a strong economy
stances.reasoning: Criticism of debt and borrow-and-spend approach signals preference for reduced government spending.

stances.quote: strong ties with our allies and partners mean to an enhanced national security, free and fair trade
stances.reasoning: Emphasis on free and fair trade indicates support for free trade policies.
